critical_code_review_comments: Meshy provider: honest placeholder handling is exemplary — /api/admin/meshy/status echoes {configured:false, placeholder:true} without leaking the sentinel MESHY_KEY_PENDING value. UI mirrors this with 'Placeholder (set real key in production secrets)' red label. Enable-toggle is orthogonal to configured — a good separation (enabled:true, configured:false is a valid state visible now).

ThreeRuntime: window.__OR3D exposes x/z/orbs/won only — clean debug surface. Movement ≈4.9 u/s observed (task note said 7 u/s — likely 7 is max speed and 4.9 is base or slightly slower on this hardware; not a bug). Collision detection is definitive (player fully stops, doesn't slide through pillar).

3D victory Back-to-Games button navigates but leaves ?play=... in URL — the runtime unmounted correctly (blank canvas after) so it's harmless, but ideally the button should route to /games (clear query) so the games list re-renders without a stale play param. Minor UX polish only.
Catalog has exactly 10 live runtimes (as advertised) + open_world_3d beta — consistent with iter130 honesty trim and validates the beta-vs-live gating story.
